entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shepherd-prophet from Tekoa (c. 760 BCE) who denounced social injustice, exploitation of the poor, and religious hypocrisy in the northern kingdom of Israel. Pioneer of the prophetic tradition of social ethics.
